description: Estimate the clicks, signups, and customers needed to recover a sponsorship cost from your own funnel assumptions. Returns an evidence-bounded result and the canonical web tool URL.

cost.description: Price of the sponsorship in US dollars as a plain number, for example 500. No currency symbol.

customerRate.description: Share of signups that become paying customers, as a percentage, so 8 means 8 percent.

margin.description: Gross margin on that revenue as a percentage, so 80 means 80 percent (not 0.8).

revenue.description: Revenue one new customer brings in during your measurement window, in US dollars as a plain number.

signupRate.description: Share of sponsorship clicks that become signups, as a percentage, so 12 means 12 percent.

name: toolfound_sponsorship_break_even
title: Newsletter sponsorship break-even calculator
